# T7 — Calibrated uncertainty for imputed cells (Task 5.1)

*Generated by `analysis/notes.py` from `outputs/tables/T7_uncertainty.csv`, `T7c_quantile_scores.csv` and the interval file.*

**Claim 1.** The published high/low band is not an uncertainty interval for imputed cells: the later survey value falls inside it in 59% of test cells (mean band width 5.0 log points).

**Claim 2.** Intervals recalibrated online as each release reveals new survey values reach nominal coverage on later releases: 80.7% for the 80% interval (mean width 12.6 log points) and 91.5% for the 90% interval (17.5). How this decomposes (selected candidate, 80% / 90%): Mondrian static thresholds 70% / 85%; one pooled static threshold 77% / 91%; expanding calibration pool at a fixed level 81% / 91%; adaptive level (ACI) as above. Steps in percentage points (80% / 90%): Mondrian → one pooled threshold +7.0 / +6.6; pooled → expanding pool +4.0 / +0.1; expanding pool → adaptive level -0.4 / +0.0. Do not attribute the gain to drift adaptation alone; read the steps above.

**Claim 3.** Covariates do not sharpen the intervals. The candidate chosen on a separate earlier block was `unconditional`; the quantile gradient-boosting model scored worse on both the selection and the test block.

**Deliverable.** `rtfp_bgd_calibrated_intervals_2026-10-05.csv`: 87,416 imputed cells in the latest release, of which 1,280 (price months 2026-04-01 to 2026-10-01) lie inside the hold-out's covariate support and get intervals; median half-width 6.2% (80%) and 8.9% (90%). All other cells are flagged `inside_support = False` and get no interval.

**Method.** Target log(survey/imputed). Time split by the release in which the survey value arrived: train 60% | selection 10% | calibration 10% | test 20%. Conformalized quantile regression (Romano et al. 2019) with Mondrian groups (stratum × months since last report; the plan's gap × distance was changed because distance is undefined for forecast cells); ACI (Gibbs & Candès 2021), γ = 0.05, processing test releases in order. Closest prior method: Gui, Barber & Ma (2023).

**Caveats.** Exploratory. The test block is almost entirely forecast-stratum cells (1100 forecast vs 29 cross-sectional cells), so coverage for cross-sectional cells is barely tested. Coverage is marginal, not per month: T7b gives per-month coverage of the static `unconditional+conformal` interval (49–89% at 80% nominal); per-month coverage of the released ACI interval is not tabulated. ACI attains long-run coverage near nominal by construction (Gibbs & Candès 2021), so its pooled coverage is weak evidence of calibration for any particular month or group. Intervals target the reported survey value, not a latent true price.

**Files.** `outputs/tables/T7_uncertainty.csv`, `T7b_coverage_by_month.csv`, `T7c_quantile_scores.csv`, interval CSV; script `analysis/t7_uncertainty.py`.
